about_the_game:
Galaxy Empires Online isn’t just a multiplayer game—it’s an entire universe where epic battles unfold, shaped by the unique laws of its players. Here, every commander carves their own path, influencing the course of history. Step into a thrilling world of interstellar warfare, where you'll fight for resources, forge the dominant ideology of your race, and explore the vast reaches of space and uncharted planets. Your ultimate goal? To become the greatest force in the galaxy and unite its warring factions—but the road to power is filled with danger, intrigue, and astonishing discoveries!

Form powerful clans, join forces with allies, and wage large-scale wars for control over entire star systems. Master strategic warfare, coordinate with your comrades, and crush your enemies. The fate of the galaxy rests in your hands! Every decision you make will determine who rises to power and what legacy future generations will remember.

But beware! Beyond rival players hungry for dominance and resources, mysterious alien civilizations lurk in the void, their motives unknown. Every action you take has consequences—one move could shift the balance of power across the galaxy.

Will you become a ruthless tyrant, crushing opposition and wielding brute force to impose your rule? Or a wise diplomat, negotiating powerful alliances and securing your legacy through cunning? Perhaps you'll rise as a brilliant strategist, leading your faction to absolute victory through tactical genius?

In Galaxy Empires Online, the universe is yours to shape. Your choices will define the future of the galaxy and leave an indelible mark on its history. Join the fight, write your own spacefaring legend, and prove that you alone deserve to rule the stars!

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS: Windows
  • Processor: Intel Core i3 / AMD
  • Memory: 6 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA GTX 1660 / AMD
  • Network: Broadband Internet connection
pc_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • OS: Windows
  • Processor: Intel Core i5 / AMD
  • Memory: 16 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA RTX 2080 / AMD
  • Network: Broadband Internet connection

short_description: A massive multiplayer game where thousands of players battle for control over a planet, belonging to rival empires! Communicate via voice chat, gather resources, upgrade technologies, build colonies, join clans or groups, and wage wars for dominance.
supported_languages:
English*, French, Italian, German, Spanish - Spain, Arabic, Bulgarian, Portuguese - Brazil, Hungarian, Vietnamese, Greek, Danish, Indonesian, Spanish - Latin America, Traditional Chinese, Simplified Chinese, Korean, Dutch, Norwegian, Polish, Portuguese - Portugal, Romanian, Russian, Thai, Turkish, Ukrainian, Finnish, Czech, Swedish, Japanese, Belarusian, Serbian, Slovak, Slovenian
*languages with full audio support
